scope: Current HUG-to-Shadow static mapping on already saved development poses. Definition of strict geometric relationship preservation, not usefulness of all approximate retargeters or outcome equivalence.
source_cases: Same six previously selected seed0 noncube poses and predeclared first-group finer repeats; historical cube separately if measured. All32 numerical checks remain separate.
reference: Actual compiled visual-object triangle domain; same metric frames/nominal current targets/native parts; no Procrustes, shifts, scale tuning or q repair.

numerical_acceptance.pass: Bound original native/assets/code; finite proper frames/named joints/full-source-URDF limits; exact decoding where checked; independent frame/FK consistency within original justified numerical checks; saved targets reproduced; stepping/time/object/hash guards pass.
numerical_acceptance.fail: Any required hard numerical invariant fails.
numerical_acceptance.purpose: Correct implementation of declared conversion, not anatomical/contact equivalence.

strict_surface_relationship_acceptance.unsigned_distance_domain: Native open anatomical triangle surfaces versus union of per-part target collider surfaces as fixed sets; not physical-contact masks or exact exterior-union signed distance.
strict_surface_relationship_acceptance.fail: Any same-part lost or added proximity cell has strictly positive area lower bound under declared cell-radius/numerical-allowance assumptions, at any declared band; or a reliable same-part query-site object-facing orientation sign reversal is established. Neither source-poor proposals nor anatomical parts are filtered.
strict_surface_relationship_acceptance.pass: Every required relationship agrees throughout the declared geometric domain, including valid orientation coverage; mismatch area upper bounds zero and no unavailable/unresolved required cells or normals. A zero observed lower bound is insufficient.
strict_surface_relationship_acceptance.unresolved: No definite counterexample, but required distance intervals/normal-feature stability/provenance leave equivalence undecidable.
strict_surface_relationship_acceptance.orientation_sign: Sign of -dot(hand_outward_normal,object_outward_normal): positive facing/opposed, negative away/aligned; tangent/degenerate/tied/buried/unreliable features unresolved. This is geometric orientation, not force/friction quality.
strict_surface_relationship_acceptance.orientation_limits: Sampled normal agreement cannot establish cellwise angular bounds. Fail evidence may be at a reliable sampled site; PASS requires separately established nearest-feature stability/domain coverage.
strict_surface_relationship_acceptance.numeric_condition: Distance area bounds conditional on declared per-query numerical allowances. Finite sanity checks are not a formal arithmetic certificate. Report assumptions and sensitivity; avoid unqualified exact certificate.
strict_surface_relationship_acceptance.justification: Zero changed resolved relationships defines the strict preservation claim itself. It is not an empirical error tolerance fitted to development metrics. Bands are inherited declared proximity scales; not simulator contact-margin thresholds.
strict_surface_relationship_acceptance.occupancy: Report prior whole-native/target occupancy and signed profiles separately. Continuous occupancy/penetration preservation is not inferred from unsigned proximity or independent signed profiles and remains unresolved without separate valid certificates.

approximate_mapping_status: A numerically accepted mapping with reported distortion is an implemented approximate mapped-simulator pipeline, not a certified native-contact-preserving mapping. Approximate adequacy for failure prediction requires separately justified distortion budgets and independent validation; no unsupported budget is invented here.
outcome_equivalence: UNTESTED. Static diagnostics cannot accept preserved failure labels, contact forces or real-world transfer.
independence: These already inspected cases are development evidence. Future grouped unseen-object/observation tests required for wider acceptance. No new cases/episodes/labels are generated in this phase.
version_policy: Preserve this frozen rule and all results. Any later approximate tolerance, morphology policy or controller change gets a separately justified version; do not loosen this definition to make inspected results pass.
